title: AlbanianLLMSafety: A Safety Evaluation Dataset for Large Language Models in Albanian

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM safety alignment and cross-lingual transfer capabilities using a natively authored Albanian prompt dataset to measure and expose disparities in safety guardrails between low-resource (Albanian) and high-resource (English) languages.

Prompting models with user-simulated queries in Albanian that contain racial and ethnic stereotypes, dehumanizing language, and discriminatory framing toward specific demographic groups, and evaluating whether the model appropriately refuses or generates harmful content.
